Game Overview

Soldiers - Capture and Control! puts players into a action experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Soldiers - Capture and Control! comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Soldiers - Capture and Control!?

Soldiers - Capture and Control! is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Soldiers - Capture and Control! free to play?

Yes, Soldiers - Capture and Control! is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
